items.title: ActiveCloud (Belarus) cloud provider hit by ransomware
items.summary: ActiveCloud disclosed on Nov 11 that an attack encrypted parts of its infrastructure; most services were restored by Nov 13 and the provider says it found no evidence of customer data theft.

items.title: Advantage Archives Inc. claimed by INC Ransom
items.summary: INC Ransom listed the US professional-services and records firm on its leak site with an attack date of Nov 13; the claim is unconfirmed by the victim.

items.title: Leware Construction Company listed by Storm-1567
items.summary: Storm-1567 posted Leware Construction Company to its leak site this month; the claim has not been confirmed by the company.

items.title: Ransomware attacks up 23% — October trend data
items.summary: Industry tracking shows ransomware attack volume rising 23%, with BlackFog's running State of Ransomware 2026 report (updated Nov 5) tracking continued leak-site growth.

ransomware.note: Named-victim reporting for November 2026 is thin; leak-site claims are unverified. Two further SOCRadar listings (n0n, Everest) did not name the victim and were omitted.

items.title: Mid-November outage cluster: Microsoft 365, FAA, Workday, Apple
items.summary: Between Nov 12 and 17, Microsoft 365, the FAA air traffic network, Workday, JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines and Apple each suffered separate major disruptions, highlighting interconnected-infrastructure risk.

items.title: Outage Atlas tracker logs November SaaS incidents
items.summary: The Outage Atlas timeline records the November 12–17 incidents as SaaS and platform failures rather than AWS or Azure infrastructure events.

outage.note: No confirmed AWS, Azure or Google Cloud infrastructure outage dated November 2026 surfaced in today's search.

items.title: CISA adds six KEVs incl. Chrome zero-day and Barracuda chain
items.summary: On Nov 10 CISA added actively exploited flaws in Microsoft Outlook, Google Chrome, Barracuda appliances, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop; Barracuda fixes were due Nov 13 and the rest Nov 24.

items.title: CISA KEV: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex
items.summary: CISA added four exploited flaws on Nov 9 with a Nov 12 federal patch deadline; attackers and victim counts were not disclosed.

items.title: Hackers exploiting critical Node2Shell flaw, CISA warns
items.summary: CISA warned that attackers are now actively exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability and added it to the KEV catalog.

items.title: Perforce Puppet deserialization bug added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a Perforce Puppet deserialization-of-untrusted-data vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain — deadline passed
items.summary: The Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain added to KEV in late October passed its federal deadline, and Ivanti shipped fixes for two more Connect Secure zero-days on Oct 29.

items.title: M 6.8 — 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor Leste (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.7 — Carhuamayo, Peru (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS green alert with tsunami flag set.

items.title: M 6.5 — Vanuatu region (Nov 23)
items.summary: USGS green alert with tsunami flag set.

items.title: M 6.4 — Mauritius–Reunion region (Nov 24)
items.summary: USGS green alert; no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 5.9 — 238 km SW of Yanglong, China (Nov 21)
items.summary: USGS yellow alert, indicating possible local damage and losses.

items.title: Catastrophic flooding in southern Brevard County, Florida
items.summary: About 24 inches of rain fell near Malabar on Nov 1–2, causing flash flooding around Melbourne and Palm Bay and a Florida emergency declaration.

items.title: Ecuador and Brazil flooding emergencies
items.summary: Ecuador reported 12 deaths and 56,000+ affected by flooding, while Brazil recognized emergencies in 44 municipalities across 13 states.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall, Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast on Nov 3, the second cyclone to strike there in under a week.

physical.note: Earthquakes from USGS significant-week feed; weather items are early November — no major US hurricane or wildfire confirmed this month.
